post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.

Returns an expiring JSON URL for the original object, not a redirect or binary body. Storage serves attachment disposition with the sanitized, escaped original filename and an independent configured download lifetime. The URL is a bearer credential until expiry; renewal requires the owner again and does not publish the video.

200.description: Original attachment URL and configured download expiration

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

404.description: VIDEO_NOT_FOUND: video missing or outside caller ownership

409.description: VIDEO_NOT_READY: video has not reached ready

get.summary: Issue a download URL for an own ready video

get.description: Returns JSON, not a redirect or video bytes. The expiring URL is a bearer credential for the original object; storage serves reusable Range requests for seeking. Renewal requires owner authentication again. Browser codec support depends on the original format; ready does not publish the video.

200.description: Inline original URL and configured expiration

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

404.description: VIDEO_NOT_FOUND: video missing or outside caller ownership

409.description: VIDEO_NOT_READY: video has not reached ready

get.summary: Issue a playback URL for an own ready video

get.description: Returns only the authenticated caller’s videos, ordered by created_at DESC then id DESC. Returns an empty array when there are none. No owner selector, filtering, pagination or publishing contract is provided.

200.description: Own videos, or an empty array

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

get.description: Owner-only, read-only lookup in every lifecycle state by immutable 12-character public ID, not the internal UUID. Returns the retained session state/deadline and nullable processing results; never renews an upload or publishes a video.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

404.description: VIDEO_NOT_FOUND: video missing or outside caller ownership

post.description: Creates a new draft and active upload session for the caller’s channel. Accepts JSON metadata for at most 10 GiB (10737418240 bytes); source bytes are uploaded directly to storage.

201.description: Draft and active upload session created

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid metadata or unknown fields

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

value.message: Video identifier could not be allocated

post.description: Owner-only renewal for an active, unexpired session. PUT bytes directly to the returned public storage URLs; no extra signed headers are required. URLs last at most 900 seconds and never beyond the session deadline. Preserve the signed hostname and returned ETags.

200.description: Requested part URLs with expiration times

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: malformed path/body, duplicate part numbers or unknown fields

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

value.message: Uploaded parts do not match the expected upload

get.description: Owner-only inventory for an active, unexpired session. Aggregates every storage page into one sorted response with actual ETags and sizes. Derive missing numbers from total_parts and renew only those parts. No client storage references or continuation tokens are used. Closed/expired sessions return 409; use video retrieval after completion.

200.description: Existing upload session and complete uploaded-part inventory

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

409.description: UPLOAD_NOT_ACTIVE: closed or expired upload session

post.description: Verifies the contiguous storage inventory and final object size, then commits completed-session/processing-video intent before publishing. HTTP 202 acknowledges asynchronous processing, not readiness. Repeated completion returns the current video without another job. Lost storage responses and matching objects at the deadline are recovered; unfinished uploads are not completed after expiry. A recoverable post-commit queue outage leaves durable intent for reconciliation.

202.description: Durable processing intent, or the current video for an already completed session

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: malformed manifest/path or unknown fields

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

409.description: UPLOAD_NOT_ACTIVE, UPLOAD_PARTS_INVALID or UPLOAD_SIZE_MISMATCH; required cleanup/error transitions commit before size rejection

value.message: Uploaded parts do not match the expected upload
Uploaded size does not match the declared size

503.description: STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: verification/cleanup remains pending for retry

post.description: Owner-only cancellation with no request body or query parameters. Retains the draft identity and closes its single session. Repeated aborted/expired sessions are idempotent. Completion and expiry serialize on the same session lock; a verified completed object is recovered and retained, returning UPLOAD_NOT_ACTIVE rather than claiming cancellation. Required storage cleanup failures remain pending for retry.

204.description: Upload aborted, or already aborted/expired; no response body

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token

409.description: UPLOAD_NOT_ACTIVE: completion already won or its verified object was recovered

declared_size.description: Source size in bytes, at most 10 GiB (10737418240 bytes).

url.description: Direct storage PUT URL; no additional signed headers are required.

etag.description: Exact storage ETag, preserved for upload completion.

parts.description: Every expected part exactly once, unique by part_number, with its exact storage ETag.
